009/**
010 * The payload layout mirrors {@link CgmAlertClearedDexHistoryLog} (opcode 370), which has been
011 * validated against captured records, and matches Tandem's cloud-export schema for this opcode.
012 * No FreeStyle Libre 2 record has been captured yet, so the layout itself is unverified on the wire.
013 */
014@HistoryLogProps(
015    opCode = 461,
016    displayName = "CGM Alert Cleared (FSL2)",
017    internalName = "LID_CGM_ALERT_CLEARED_FSL2"
018)
019public class CgmAlertClearedFsl2HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
020
021    private int alertId;
022    private CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert;
023    private int sensorType;
024
025    public CgmAlertClearedFsl2HistoryLog() {}
026    public CgmAlertClearedFsl2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int alertId, int sensorType) {
027        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
028        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, alertId, sensorType);
029        this.alertId = alertId;
030        this.alert = CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId);
031        this.sensorType = sensorType;
032
033    }
034
035    public CgmAlertClearedFsl2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert, int sensorType) {
036        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, alert != null ? alert.id() : 0, sensorType);
037        this.alert = alert;
038
039    }
040
041    public CgmAlertClearedFsl2HistoryLog(int alertId, int sensorType) {
042        this(0, 0, alertId, sensorType);
043    }
044
045    public CgmAlertClearedFsl2HistoryLog(CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert, int sensorType) {
046        this(0, 0, alert, sensorType);
047    }
048
049    public int typeId() {
050        return 461;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * <table border="1">
055     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmAlertClearedFsl2HistoryLog:</caption>
056     * <tr><td><code>alertId</code></td><td><code>raw[10]</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>alert</code></td><td><code>CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>sensorType</code></td><td><code>raw[11]</code></td></tr>
059     * </table>
060     */
061    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
062        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
063        this.cargo = raw;
064        parseBase(raw);
065        this.alertId = raw[10];
066        this.alert = CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId);
067        this.sensorType = raw[11];
068
069    }
070
071    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int alertId, int sensorType) {
072        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
073            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(461, 0),
074            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
075            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
076            new byte[]{ (byte) alertId },
077            new byte[]{ (byte) sensorType }));
078    }
079
080    public int getAlertId() {
081        return alertId;
082    }
083
084    public CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert getAlert() {
085        return alert;
086    }
087
088    /**
089     * The type of glucose sensor which raised the alert. Tandem's export schema maps 0 to Invalid
090     * and 2 to CGM_TYPE_LIBRE2 for this opcode.
091     */
092    public int getSensorType() {
093        return sensorType;
094    }
095
096    public CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType getSensorTypeEnum() {
097        return CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType.fromId(sensorType);
098    }
099}
